2607.28086.title: Distilling Answer Set Programming Theories from Large Language Models
2607.28086.paper_summary: Writing Answer Set Programming (ASP) theories from scratch is a difficult and time-consuming task. We take a neurosymbolic approach to study whether a model can distill complete and correct theories, given a fixed agent harness with the solver in the loop. The protocol is dataset-agnostic: with a single prompt and an empty file as the starting point the model is given a 1-hour time limit to derive a complete theory. We chose VQA as the application domain, three benchmarks (CLEVR, GQA, CLEVRER), as these are publicly available and non-trivial. In order to study the model scale required for solving this task we nine different models: four frontier (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5, DeepSeek V4 Pro), two mid-tier (DeepSeek V4 Flash, gpt-oss-120b), and three open-weights (qwen3.6-27b, gpt-oss-20b, qwen3.5-9b). Three of four frontier models reach 100% on CLEVR and 92.8%-98.8% on GQA; on CLEVRER, Sonnet, Opus, DeepSeek V4 Pro score 92.7%-95.3%. GPT-5 reaches 98.7% on CLEVR but drops to 41.8% on GQA and to 86.7% on CLEVRER. Adding handwritten reference theories from other datasets moves the other three frontier models by at most +/-3.4 pp but reduces GPT-5's accuracy by 3-19 pp. We release the code, prompts, and theories distilled.
2607.28086.paper_summary_zh: 撰寫從零開始的答案集程式設計（ASP）理論是一項困難且耗時的任務。<lb/>我們採取神經符號方法來研究在固定代理與解決器循環的情況下，模型是否能夠提煉出完整且正確的理論。<lb/>該協議與數據集無關：模型在一個提示和一個空文件作為起點的情況下，給予1小時的時間限制來推導出完整的理論。<lb/>我們選擇了VQA作為應用領域，三個基準（CLEVR、GQA、CLEVRER），因為這些都是公開可用且非平凡的。<lb/>為了研究解決此任務所需的模型規模，我們使用了九個不同的模型：四個前沿模型（Claude Sonnet 4.6、Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5、DeepSeek V4 Pro）、兩個中階模型（DeepSeek V4 Flash、gpt-oss-120b）和三個開放權重模型（qwen3.6-27b、gpt-oss-20b、qwen3.5-9b）。<lb/>四個前沿模型中有三個在CLEVR上達到100%，在GQA上達到92.8%-98.8%；在CLEVRER上，Sonnet、Opus、DeepSeek V4 Pro的得分為92.7%-95.3%。<lb/>GPT-5在CLEVR上達到98.7%，但在GQA上降至41.8%，在CLEVRER上降至86.7%。<lb/>從其他數據集添加手寫參考理論使得其他三個前沿模型最多變動+/-3.4個百分點，但降低了GPT-5的準確率3-19個百分點。<lb/>我們發布了代碼、提示和提煉出的理論。
